fe.judge_summary: Recognizable Basecamp single-file prototype with broad route scaffolding and several working in-memory workflows. Material navigation, card-step, input-escaping and state-continuity failures; many file, administrative and lifecycle controls are stubs. Notes and theme alone persist. Browser rendering was blocked by environment policy, so visual and responsive assessments rely on inspected references, source and DOM evidence and remain provisional.

request_hardening.notes: Some required-field and identifier checks, missing-auth rejection and safe generic error bodies exist, but credential bypasses, absent authorization, weak type validation, permissive ownership and request limits are major failures.

code_quality.notes: The single file is organized and named clearly enough to inspect, with some shared helpers and straightforward CRUD. Extensive duplicated dictionaries, untyped request bodies, unused abstractions and incomplete shared invariants make extension fragile.
evidence: The complete delta is a 3,308-line submission/server.py; all sixteen seed files are unchanged. Sections group domain stores, seed, auth, handlers and error handling.
submission/server.py:62-66 centralizes ID generation with an RLock; URL builders and event creation are reused, and core typed stores share object identity with recordings.
AST/source inspection found _recording_envelope, _auth_person and several other helpers are not used by handlers; repeated envelopes and body-parsing expressions dominate endpoint code.
Handlers accept raw Request and call request.json rather than typed models; runtime generated OpenAPI contains no requestBody for any of 206 operations.
Hard-coded bucket 10, shared global account stores, permissive dictionary update and inconsistent lifecycle/count propagation require changes in many handlers to maintain an invariant.
No tests, dependency manifest or implementation-specific setup/coverage document were added; inherited SDK/INIT documentation is unchanged.

scope_honesty.notes: Some limitations are acknowledged in source comments and some unavailable details fail with 404. Many incomplete operations nevertheless report successful mutation or fabricated completion, conflicting with the production-shaped/full-surface claims.

be.judge_summary: Complete registered endpoint breadth with substantial in-memory core CRUD and a recognizable sample graph. Contract serialization and navigation, lifecycle/cross-resource invariants, authentic credential/role checks, packaging and explicit handling of incomplete subsystems are substantially below production-shaped expectations. Evaluation ran through FastAPI's in-process HTTP transport; the sandbox prevented listening-socket verification.
